title: Chapter 234: No One Else
html:
Watching Chen Ge leave, Inspector Lee felt a growing unease. He called Ah Yong into the room. “Something has come up tonight. I’ll be leaving early.”

“Is it related to Chen Ge?”

“Yes. Ever since his parents disappeared, he has kept a cool head no matter what happened. This is the first time I’ve seen him react so strongly.” Inspector Lee returned the file to his desk. “Tell the night-shift officers to remain alert. We may have an emergency tonight.”

“Okay.”

Inspector Lee changed into his casual clothes and left.

…

After leaving the station, Chen Ge took a taxi back to New Century Park and locked himself inside the staff break room. The man who drove Zhang Ya to suicide must be searching for the Ghost Stories Society too. He was last seen at Building Three of Fang Hwa Apartments. There’s a good chance he reached the twenty-fourth floor and found them.

Chen Ge knew nothing about the society, and the flyer provided only its location.

Zhang Ya died years ago, and too much time has passed. Even if the police arrest Zhu Xiu, proving his crime will be difficult. They need concrete evidence.Chen Ge had never studied or practiced law, so he did not know what punishment awaited a man who drove a young woman to suicide.

If you do something wrong, you have to face the consequences.Chen Ge removed the flyer from his pocket. Perhaps I should let Zhang Ya deal with him herself. My task is to find the bastard.

The image of a half-open, bloodred door caught his attention. It was the society’s emblem.

If I perform the elevator ritual at midnight and press the button for the twenty-fourth floor, it will take me to the Ghost Stories Society.

There were other warnings written at the bottom of the flyer.

“The ritual must be performed alone at midnight. If another passenger enters the elevator before the process is complete, you must start again from the beginning. No matter what you see in the corridors along the way, do not leave the elevator.

“Whether or not you find the society, you must bring a mask. Every member must conceal their true identity. Revealing personal information or asking about another member is forbidden.

“The final and most important rule: no member may disclose information about the Ghost Stories Society or allow anyone else to learn that they are searching for it.”

Chen Ge could satisfy all these requirements.

I can go alone, but the rules don’t say I can’t bring ghosts.Chen Ge packed the ballpoint pen and the cassette, then reconsidered. It still did not feel like enough.

Xu Yin’s power is too restricted. He can only help while the cassette is playing, and carrying a full-sized tape recorder is inconvenient.

After walking through the Haunted House, he decided to bring Xiaoxiao as well.I don’t know whether the society’s members are human or ghosts. Carrying Doctor Skull-cracker’s hammer and the cleaver might put them needlessly on guard.

But it’s better to be careful.

Using a length of cord, Chen Ge strapped the red-cloth-wrapped cleaver to his calf. He left the hammer behind; it was far too conspicuous. That’s everything I can do for now.

After checking his equipment, Chen Ge ordered a compact cassette player online, though it would not arrive until the following day. He then took out pen and paper and listed everything he needed to remember that night.

At 10:30 p.m., his phone finished charging, and Chen Ge left the Haunted House for Fang Hwa Apartments.

The night was moonless and starless. Inside and outside the taxi seemed like separate worlds, and Chen Ge felt like a visitor passing through a city of colored lights.

He reached Fang Hwa Apartments around 11 p.m. He had planned to slip in through the back entrance, but one glance at the security booth changed his mind.

“Gu Feiyu? You’re already back at work?” Chen Ge saw the young man inside the post wearing his security uniform and was surprised. It had only been one or two days since the madwoman captured him, but he was already back at his post.

“Brother Chen, why are you back here?” Gu Feiyu was embarrassed. Facing Chen Ge again, his attitude was completely different.

“I have some business here and wanted to check on you.” Chen Ge smiled. “How is your recovery? Why not take a few more days off?”

“I came to the city with my uncle. One day in the hospital costs three days’ wages. My uncle and family had to cover the medical bill that night.” Gu Feiyu looked ashamed. “I’ve been here a month and haven’t saved anything. I only keep creating trouble for everyone.”

“That’s nice of you to think about them.” Chen Ge took out his phone. “I’ll be leaving for the third block in a minute, and I have a favor to ask of you.”

“Of course. Anything you need.” Chen Ge had saved his life, so Gu Feiyu would never refuse him.

“Listen carefully.” Chen Ge set both their phones to vibrate. “If I call after midnight, don’t answer. If I hang up after three rings, I need you to do one simple thing.”

“What is it?”

“Call the police immediately.”

Gu Feiyu had more questions, but Chen Ge stopped him. “Just follow my instructions. Remember: don’t answer my call. Call the police instead.”

“Understood.” Ever since Gu Feiyu was saved by Chen Ge, he had felt that Chen Ge was destined for something big.

Leaving the security booth, Chen Ge entered Fang Hwa Apartments and headed toward Building Three. Its exterior looked perfectly ordinary, yet somewhere inside, the Ghost Stories Society convened.

If anyone enters during the ritual, I’ll have to start over. In any other building, interruption would be likely, but this one is different. According to Wang Xin’s adoptive mother, none of the tenants use the elevator at night because the building is cursed. In hindsight, their supernatural experiences were probably connected to the Ghost Stories Society. They may have encountered people—or ghosts—searching for it.

Chen Ge hid in the stairwell until 11:30 p.m. The elevator had remained on the same floor, meaning no one had used it. Perhaps it was because midnight approached, but as the minutes passed, the building grew steadily colder.

The temperature inside the building is even lower than outside. Have all the tenants gotten used to this?

At 11:50 p.m., Chen Ge left the stairwell and approached the elevator. No one should interrupt me now.
